decision: Plan framing: operator asked for a hard dashboard contract — 'a card may render as Needs Action only if its producer can prove the issue exists for the currently selected scope.' Recast as a fail-closed render gate built on 001 (clears_when/resolution_class/suppress-at-source) + 004 (provenance/freshness/architecture stale-to-uncertainty demotion). Grounded in an Explore probe of the live render path (operator_console.ActionItem, dashboard_relevance.is_item_relevant_to_project, action_resolvability.suppress_resolved, state_projection.freshness_status, architecture_regen.render_architecture_status). Probe findings: (a) suppress_resolved defaults to render-unless-proven-resolved, clears_when=None always renders; (b) ActionItem has project_name but no explicit scope — relevance is INFERRED by a heuristic ladder, a boolean (no GLOBAL badge); (c) ONLY architecture demotes on staleness — reconcile/capabilities/gates keep last-known cards as live Needs Action when stale; (d) freshness is snapshot-wide, no per-source stamping; (e) global state is computed once (not per-project) but per-project OUTPUT caches (what-now-cache.json) exist and the same global card renders in every project view unbadged. Five features: F001 unified three-way render gate (render/suppress/demote) inverting the default to suppress-unless-proven-live; F002 explicit producer-asserted scope + applicability lattice (heuristic ladder demoted to logged fallback); F003 per-source freshness; F004 generalize architecture's stale-to-uncertainty demotion to all producers; F005 global/project separation (GLOBAL badge, no cache resurrection) + four-part render-truth invariant. status: draft, pre_impl is the human gate.

Pre-lock revision per operator review (6 blocking issues). (1) Added objective_contract.json (goal_type=new_feature requires it) with 4 journeys incl. the pinned QuantRE regression + completion_test. (2) F002: removed the silent 'scope inferred from project_name' default — new producers MUST set explicit scope; scope-unset legacy items route through a logged legacy_adapter and are demotion-eligible, never silently project work. (3) F002: plan/feature scope applies only if plan_id resolves to the selected project; failed resolution demotes, not renders. (4) F004: named the demotion target explicitly — band=Band.INFO (priority 2, below ADVISORY), resolution_class=blocked_external, section='status_uncertain'. (5) F001: pinned a normative 6-step gate order and made F001 the SOLE demote decision (F004 only builds the card) to kill the F001/F004 double-demotion-path risk. (6) F005: pinned the exact QuantRE regression in acceptance (selected project=quantre-migration + stale per-project missing_snapshot cache + clean live global reconcile -> zero setup-drift cards) backed by a committed fixture.

Gate-order refinement to confirm at lock: the operator's stated order listed 'resolution_class missing? demote' AFTER 'predicate unresolved? render', which would render before checking resolution_class. The plan makes resolution_class a RENDER PRECONDITION (step 4, before the resolved/render branch) so a card missing resolution_class can never render. This preserves the operator's intent (a Needs Action card must carry a resolution_class) and keeps the gate deterministic. Flagged for explicit operator confirmation at pre_impl.

LOCK: operator locked the plan (status draft->active), clearing the pre_impl human gate, with the explicit instruction 'lock/build 005 first'. The D003 gate-order refinement is OPERATOR-CONFIRMED verbatim: (1) scope applies? else suppress; (2) source fresh/evaluable? else demote; (3) clears_when present/evaluable? else demote; (4) resolution_class set? else demote; (5) predicate resolved? suppress; (6) predicate unresolved? render. Prerequisite export-model fix landed on main as PR #21 (squash 1e9b02c) before build. Build proceeds operator-style with red/green TDD (python.md), F001 (render gate) first as the backbone.

F001 build interpretation: step 3's 'clears_when present AND evaluable' is implemented as 'present (not None)' because (a) the closed predicate registry guarantees the predicate NAME is known at ClearsWhen construction time, and (b) the predicate's own input availability is covered by step 2's source-evaluability (if the source feeding the predicate's params did not evaluate, step 2 already demotes). Per-param introspection of live_state is therefore not duplicated in step 3. Also decided: the fail-closed proof obligations (steps 2-4) apply ONLY to NEEDS_ACTION-band cards (the contract's subject); lower-band advisory/info/ready cards are not demoted for a missing predicate (they make no Needs Action claim) but are still suppressed by step-1 scope and by a resolved predicate. Gate is pure: scope_applies (F002) + source_fresh/source_evaluable (F003) are injected, not computed inside the gate. 12 TDD cases green.
